# File Summary

## Purpose
This file contains a packed representation of the entire repository's contents.
It is designed to be easily consumable by AI systems for analysis, code review,
or other automated processes.

## File Format
The content is organized as follows:
1. This summary section
2. Repository information
3. Directory structure
4. Repository files (if enabled)
5. Multiple file entries, each consisting of:
  a. A header with the file path (## File: path/to/file)
  b. The full contents of the file in a code block

## Usage Guidelines
- This file should be treated as read-only. Any changes should be made to the
  original repository files, not this packed version.
- When processing this file, use the file path to distinguish
  between different files in the repository.
- Be aware that this file may contain sensitive information. Handle it with
  the same level of security as you would the original repository.

## Notes
- Some files may have been excluded based on .gitignore rules and Repomix's configuration
- Binary files are not included in this packed representation. Please refer to the Repository Structure section for a complete list of file paths, including binary files
- Files matching patterns in .gitignore are excluded
- Files matching default ignore patterns are excluded
- Files are sorted by Git change count (files with more changes are at the bottom)

## File: repo/include/core/engine.h
```c
#pragma once

#include <SDL3/SDL.h>
#include <string>
#include "input.h"
#include "timer.h"
#include "error_handling.h"
#include "PrimitiveRenderer.h"
#include "../graphics/point2D.h"
#include "logs.h"
#include "game/player.h"
#include "graphics/camera.h"
#include "world/tilemap.h"
#include "physics/collider.h"
enum class GameState {
    Playing,
    Victory
};

struct Portal {
    AABB triggerBox;
    float centerX{0.0f};
    float centerY{0.0f};
    bool active{false};
};
struct Star {
    float x{0.0f};
    float y{0.0f};
    float radius{12.0f};
    bool collected{false};

    AABB GetCollider() const {
        return AABB(x - radius, y - radius, radius * 2.0f, radius * 2.0f);
    }
};
class Engine
{
private:

    SDL_Window* window;
    SDL_Renderer* renderer;
    PrimitiveRenderer* primitiveRenderer;

    bool running;

    int width;
    int height;
    int fps;

    bool fullscreen;

    Input input;
    Timer timer;
    Player* player;
    BitmapHandler mapTileset;
    Tilemap tilemap;
    Tilemap victoryMap;
    float victoryStartX{960.0f};   // punkt, w którym gracz się pojawia
    float victoryStartY{704.0f};
    Camera camera;
    std::vector<Star> stars;
    int starsCollected{0};
    GameState currentState{GameState::Playing};
    Portal portal;
public:

    Engine();
    ~Engine();

    bool Initialize(
        const std::string& title,
        int width,
        int height,
        bool fullscreen,
        int fps);

    void Run();
    void ProcessEvents();
    void Update(float dt);
    void DrawVictoryText();
    void Render();
    void ClearScreen(
    Uint8 r,
    Uint8 g,
    Uint8 b,
    Uint8 a = 255);
    void Shutdown();
};
```

## File: repo/include/core/object_hierarchy.h
```c
#ifndef ENGINE2D_OBJECT_HIERARCHY_H
    #define ENGINE2D_OBJECT_HIERARCHY_H
    #pragma once

    #include <SDL3/SDL.h>
    #include <vector>
    #include "graphics/bitmap_handler.h"
    #include "graphics/camera.h"
    class PrimitiveRenderer;
    class Point2D;

    class GameObject
    {
    public:
        virtual ~GameObject() = default;
    };

    class UpdatableObject : virtual public GameObject
    {
    public:
        virtual ~UpdatableObject() = default;
        virtual void Update(float deltaTime) = 0;
    };

    class DrawableObject : virtual public GameObject
    {
    public:
        virtual ~DrawableObject() = default;
        virtual void Draw(PrimitiveRenderer& renderer) = 0;
    };

    class TransformableObject : virtual public GameObject
    {
    public:
        virtual ~TransformableObject() = default;

        virtual void Translate(float tx, float ty) = 0;
        virtual void Rotate(float alpha) = 0;
        virtual void Rotate(float alpha, const Point2D& center) = 0;
        virtual void Scale(float kx, float ky) = 0;
        virtual void Scale(float kx, float ky, const Point2D& center) = 0;
    };

    class ShapeObject : public DrawableObject, public TransformableObject
    {
    protected:
        SDL_Color color{255, 255, 255, 255};

    public:
        virtual ~ShapeObject() = default;

        void SetColor(SDL_Color c) { color = c; }
        SDL_Color GetColor() const { return color; }
    };
    class AnimatedObject : virtual public GameObject{
    public:
        virtual ~AnimatedObject() = default;
        virtual void Animate(float deltaTime) = 0;
    };

    class BitmapObject : public DrawableObject, public TransformableObject {
    protected:
        Point2D* position{nullptr};
        float rotationAngle{0.0f};
        float scaleFactor{1.0f};
        float scaleFactorY{1.0f};
        std::vector<const BitmapHandler*> bitmaps;
    public:
        BitmapObject();
        BitmapObject(float x, float y);
        virtual ~BitmapObject();
        BitmapObject(const BitmapObject&) = delete;
        BitmapObject& operator=(const BitmapObject&) = delete;
        BitmapObject(BitmapObject&& other) noexcept;
        BitmapObject& operator=(BitmapObject&& other) noexcept;
        float GetX() const;
        float GetY() const;
        void AddBitmap(const BitmapHandler* bitmap);
        void Translate(float tx, float ty) override;
        void Rotate(float alpha) override;
        void Rotate(float alpha, const Point2D& center) override;
        void Scale(float kx, float ky) override;
        void Scale(float kx, float ky, const Point2D& center) override;

        void Draw(PrimitiveRenderer& renderer) override;

    };

    class SpriteObject : public BitmapObject, public AnimatedObject {
    private:
        std::size_t firstFrame{0};
        std::size_t frameCount{0};
        std::size_t currentFrame{0};
        float elapsed{0.0f};
        float frameDuration{0.125f};
        bool animating{false};
    public:
        using BitmapObject::BitmapObject;
        bool SetAnimation(std::size_t first, std::size_t count);
        void SetAnimating(bool enabled);
        void Animate(float deltaTime) override;
        void Draw(PrimitiveRenderer& renderer) override;

        virtual void Draw(PrimitiveRenderer& renderer, const Camera& camera);
        std::size_t GetCurrentFrame() const { return currentFrame; }
    };
    #endif
```

## File: repo/include/game/player.h
```c
#ifndef ENGINE2D_PLAYER_H
#define ENGINE2D_PLAYER_H
#pragma once
#include "core/object_hierarchy.h"
#include "graphics/linesegment.h"
#include "graphics/point2D.h"
#include <vector>
#include "core/timer.h"
#include "system/input.h"
#include "physics/collider.h"
#include "world/tilemap.h"
class Player: public UpdatableObject, public SpriteObject {
private:
    float speed{200.0f};
    std::vector<BitmapHandler> sprites;
    bool spritesLoaded{false};
    const Input& input;
    float colliderW{24.0f};
    float colliderH{28.0f};

public:
    Player(float startX, float startY, const Input& inputModule);
    void Update(float deltaTime, const Tilemap& map);
    void Update(float deltaTime) override;
    void Draw(PrimitiveRenderer& renderer) override;

    void Draw(PrimitiveRenderer &renderer, const Camera &camera) override;
    void SetPosition(float x, float y);
    bool HasSprites() const { return spritesLoaded; }
    AABB GetCollider() const {
        float currentW = colliderW * scaleFactor;
        float currentH = colliderH * scaleFactorY;
        return AABB(GetX() - currentW / 2.0f, GetY() - currentH / 2.0f, currentW, currentH);
    }
};
#endif //ENGINE2D_PLAYER_H
```

```c
#ifndef ENGINE2D_BITMAP_HANDLER_H
#define ENGINE2D_BITMAP_HANDLER_H
#pragma once

#include <SDL3/SDL.h>
#include <string>


class BitmapHandler {
private:
    SDL_Surface* surface{nullptr};
public:
    BitmapHandler() = default;
    BitmapHandler(int width, int height);
    explicit BitmapHandler(const std::string& filepath);

    ~BitmapHandler();


    BitmapHandler(const BitmapHandler&) = delete;
    BitmapHandler& operator=(const BitmapHandler&) = delete;
    BitmapHandler(BitmapHandler&& other) noexcept;
    BitmapHandler& operator=(BitmapHandler&& other) noexcept;
    bool create_bitmap(int width,int height);
    void delete_bitmap();
    bool load_from_file(const std::string& filepath);
    bool save_to_file(const std::string& filepath);
    bool LoadFragment(const std::string& filepath, const SDL_Rect& sourceRect);
```

## File: repo/include/graphics/camera.h
```c
#ifndef ENGINE2D_CAMERA_H
#define ENGINE2D_CAMERA_H
#pragma once
#include <algorithm>
struct Camera {
private:
    float x{0.0f};
    float y{0.0f};
    int viewPortWidth{1280};
    int viewPortHeight{720};
public:
    Camera() = default;
    Camera(int width, int height) : viewPortWidth(width), viewPortHeight(height){}
    void Follow(float targetX, float targetY) {
        x = targetX - viewPortWidth / 2.0f;
        y = targetY - viewPortHeight / 2.0f;
    }

    void ClampToBounds(float worldWidth, float worldHeight) {
        if (worldWidth > viewPortWidth) {
            x = std::clamp(x, 0.0f, worldWidth - viewPortWidth);
        }
        else {
            x = (worldWidth - viewPortWidth) / 2.0f;
        }
        if (worldHeight > viewPortHeight)
            y = std::clamp(y, 0.0f, worldHeight - viewPortHeight);
        else
            y = (worldHeight - viewPortHeight) / 2.0f;
    }
    float WorldToScreenX(float worldX) const { return worldX - x; }
    float WorldToScreenY(float worldY) const { return worldY - y; }
    float ScreenToWorldX(float screenX) const { return screenX + x; }
    float ScreenToWorldY(float screenY) const { return screenY + y; }
    float GetX() const { return x; }
    float GetY() const { return y; }
    int GetViewportWidth() const { return viewPortWidth; }
    int GetViewportHeight() const { return viewPortHeight; }
};
#endif //ENGINE2D_CAMERA_H
```

## File: repo/include/physics/collider.h
```c
#ifndef ENGINE2D_COLLIDER_H
#define ENGINE2D_COLLIDER_H
#pragma once
#include "graphics/point2D.h"
struct AABB {
    float x{0.0f};
    float y{0.0f};
    float w{0.0f};
    float h{0.0f};

    AABB() = default;
    AABB(float x, float y, float w, float h) : x(x), y(y), w(w), h(h) {}
    bool Intersects(const AABB& other) const {
        return (x < other.x + other.w &&
                x + w > other.x &&
                y < other.y + other.h &&
                y + h > other.y);
    }

    bool Contains(float px, float py) const{
        return (px >= x && px <= x + w &&
                py >= y && py <= y + h);
    }
};
#endif //ENGINE2D_COLLIDER_H
```

## File: repo/include/system/math.h
```c
#ifndef ENGINE2D_MATH_H
#define ENGINE2D_MATH_H
#pragma once
#include "cmath"
struct coordinates {
    float x = 0.0;
    float y = 0.0;
    coordinates() = default;
    coordinates(float x,float y) : x(x), y(y){}

    coordinates operator+(const coordinates& other) const {return coordinates(x + other.x, y + other.y);}
    coordinates operator-(const coordinates& other) const {return coordinates(x - other.x, y - other.y);}
    coordinates operator*(float scalar) const {return coordinates(x * scalar, y * scalar);}
    coordinates operator/(float scalar) const {return coordinates(x / scalar, y / scalar);}
    coordinates operator+=(const coordinates& other) {(x += other.x, y += other.y); return *this;}
    coordinates operator-=(const coordinates& other) {(x -= other.x, y -= other.y); return *this;}
};
#endif //ENGINE2D_MATH_H
```

```c
#ifndef ENGINE2D_TILEMAP_H
#define ENGINE2D_TILEMAP_H
#pragma once
#include "object_hierarchy.h"
#include <string>
#include <vector>
class BitmapHandler;
class PrimitiveRenderer;
struct Camera;
class Tilemap : public DrawableObject {
private:
    int mapWidth{0};
    int mapHeight{0};
    int tileSize{32};
    const BitmapHandler* tileset{nullptr};
    std::vector<int> tiles;
    int firstSolidTile{-1};

public:
    Tilemap() = default;
    Tilemap(int width, int height, int tileSize, const BitmapHandler* tilesetBitmap);
    void SetTiles(const std::vector<int>& tiles,int width, int height);
    bool LoadFromFile(const std::string& path, const BitmapHandler* tilesetBitmap);
    bool isSolid(int tileX, int tileY) const;
    bool CheckCollision(float worldX, float worldY, float width, float height) const;
    int GetTileSize() const { return tileSize; }
    int GetMapWidth() const { return mapWidth; }
    int GetMapHeight() const { return mapHeight; }
    int GetWorldWidth() const { return mapWidth * tileSize; }
    int GetWorldHeight() const { return mapHeight * tileSize; }
    void Draw(PrimitiveRenderer& renderer) override;
    void Draw(PrimitiveRenderer& renderer, const Camera& camera);
    bool IsTileSolid(int tileID) const {
        if (firstSolidTile >= 0)
            return tileID >= firstSolidTile;
        return tileID == 1090 || tileID == 1;
    }

    bool IsSolidAtTile(int tx, int ty) const {
        if (tx < 0 || tx >= mapWidth || ty < 0 || ty >= mapHeight) {
            return true;
        }
        int id = tiles[ty * mapWidth + tx];
        return IsTileSolid(id);
    }
};
#endif //ENGINE2D_TILEMAP_H
```

```cpp
#include "engine.h"
#include "LineSegment.h"
#include <iostream>

Engine::Engine()
{
    window = nullptr;
    renderer = nullptr;
    primitiveRenderer = nullptr;
    player = nullptr;
    running = false;

}

Engine::~Engine()
{
Shutdown();
}

bool Engine::Initialize(
    const std::string& title,
    int w,
    int h,
    bool fs,
    int targetFPS)
{
    width = w;
    height = h;
    fullscreen = fs;
    fps = targetFPS;
    Log::Init("logs.txt");
    if (!SDL_Init(SDL_INIT_VIDEO))
    {
        ErrorHandle::SDLError("Failed to initialize SDL");
        Shutdown();
        return false;
    }

    Uint32 flags = SDL_WINDOW_RESIZABLE;

    if (fullscreen)
        flags = SDL_WINDOW_FULLSCREEN;

    window = SDL_CreateWindow(
        title.c_str(),
        width,
        height,
        flags);

    if (window == nullptr)
    {
        ErrorHandle::SDLError("Failed to create window");
        Shutdown();
        return false;
    }

    renderer = SDL_CreateRenderer(
        window,
        nullptr);

    if (renderer == nullptr)
    {
        ErrorHandle::SDLError("Failed to create renderer");
        Shutdown();
        return false;
    }
    primitiveRenderer = new PrimitiveRenderer(renderer);
    const char* basePath = SDL_GetBasePath();
    const std::string assetsPath = std::string(basePath ? basePath : "") + "assets/";
    if (!mapTileset.load_from_file(assetsPath + "tileset.bmp"))
    {
        Log::Error("Failed to load assets/tileset.bmp");
        Shutdown();
        return false;
    }
    if (!tilemap.LoadFromFile(assetsPath + "world.map", &mapTileset))
    {
        Log::Error("Failed to load assets/world.map");
        Shutdown();
        return false;
    }
    if (!victoryMap.LoadFromFile(assetsPath + "victory.map", &mapTileset))
    {
        Log::Error("Failed to load assets/victory.map");
        Shutdown();
        return false;
    }

    const float startX = 624.0f;
    const float startY = 1584.0f;
    player = new Player(startX, startY, input);
    if (!player->HasSprites())
    {
        Log::Error("Failed to load assets/player.bmp");
        Shutdown();
        return false;
    }
    const AABB spawn = player->GetCollider();
    stars.clear();
    starsCollected = 0;

    const int tSize = tilemap.GetTileSize();
    std::vector<std::pair<int, int>> spawnTiles = {
        {15, 12},
        {15, 58},
        {105, 55}
    };

    for (auto [tx, ty] : spawnTiles) {
        while (tilemap.IsSolidAtTile(tx, ty) && tx < tilemap.GetMapWidth() - 3) {
            tx++;
        }

        float worldX = tx * tSize + tSize / 2.0f;
        float worldY = ty * tSize + tSize / 2.0f;
        stars.push_back({worldX, worldY, 12.0f, false});
    }
    currentState = GameState::Playing;

    portal.centerX = 98.0f * tSize;
    portal.centerY = 19.0f * tSize;

    const int baseLeftX = 95;
    const int baseTopY  = 18;
    const int baseCols  = 6;
    const int baseRows  = 3;
    const float padding = 10.0f;

    portal.triggerBox = AABB(
        baseLeftX * tSize - padding,
        baseTopY  * tSize - padding,
        baseCols  * tSize + padding * 2.0f,
        baseRows  * tSize + padding * 2.0f
    );
    portal.active = false;
    if (tilemap.CheckCollision(spawn.x, spawn.y, spawn.w, spawn.h))
    {
        Log::Error("Player start position is blocked");
        Shutdown();
        return false;
    }
    camera = Camera(width, height);
    camera.Follow(startX, startY);
    camera.ClampToBounds(static_cast<float>(tilemap.GetWorldWidth()), static_cast<float>(tilemap.GetWorldHeight()));
    running = true;
    Log::Info("Engine initialized successfully");
    return true;
}

void Engine::ProcessEvents()
{
    SDL_Event event;
    while (SDL_PollEvent(&event))
    {
        if (event.type == SDL_EVENT_QUIT)
        {
            running = false;
        }

        input.HandleEvent(event);
    }
}

void Engine::Update(float dt)
{

    if (currentState == GameState::Victory) {
        if (input.IsKeyDown(SDL_SCANCODE_ESCAPE)) running = false;

        if (player) {
            player->Update(dt, victoryMap);
            camera.Follow(player->GetX(), player->GetY());
        }
        camera.ClampToBounds(static_cast<float>(victoryMap.GetWorldWidth()),
                             static_cast<float>(victoryMap.GetWorldHeight()));
        return;
    }

    if (player) {
        player->Update(dt, tilemap);
        camera.Follow(player->GetX(), player->GetY());
        AABB playerBox = player->GetCollider();

        for (auto& star : stars) {
            if (!star.collected && playerBox.Intersects(star.GetCollider())) {
                star.collected = true;
                starsCollected++;
                if (starsCollected >= 3) {
                    portal.active = true;
                }
            }
        }
        
        if (portal.active && playerBox.Intersects(portal.triggerBox)) {
            currentState = GameState::Victory;
            player->SetPosition(victoryStartX, victoryStartY);
            camera.Follow(victoryStartX, victoryStartY);
            camera.ClampToBounds(static_cast<float>(victoryMap.GetWorldWidth()),
                                 static_cast<float>(victoryMap.GetWorldHeight()));
            return;
        }
    }

    camera.ClampToBounds(static_cast<float>(tilemap.GetWorldWidth()),
                         static_cast<float>(tilemap.GetWorldHeight()));
}

void Engine::Render()
{
    if (currentState == GameState::Victory) {
        ClearScreen(15, 20, 30);
        victoryMap.Draw(*primitiveRenderer, camera);
        if (player) player->Draw(*primitiveRenderer, camera);
        DrawVictoryText();
        SDL_RenderPresent(renderer);
        return;
    }
    ClearScreen(30,30,30);
    tilemap.Draw(*primitiveRenderer, camera);

    if (portal.active) {
        float px = portal.centerX - camera.GetX();
        float py = portal.centerY - camera.GetY();

        SDL_Color outerCyan{0, 255, 220, 255};
        SDL_Color innerWhite{200, 255, 255, 255};

        primitiveRenderer->DrawCircle(px, py, 20.0f, outerCyan);
        primitiveRenderer->DrawCircle(px, py, 10.0f, innerWhite);
    }



    for (const auto& star : stars) {
        if (star.collected) continue;

        float sx = star.x - camera.GetX();
        float sy = star.y - camera.GetY();
        float r  = star.radius;
        float diag = r * 0.7f;

        SDL_Color gold{255, 215, 0, 255};
        SDL_Color lightGold{255, 250, 160, 255};

        primitiveRenderer->DrawLineSDL(sx - r, sy, sx + r, sy, gold);
        primitiveRenderer->DrawLineSDL(sx, sy - r, sx, sy + r, gold);

        primitiveRenderer->DrawLineSDL(sx - diag, sy - diag, sx + diag, sy + diag, lightGold);
        primitiveRenderer->DrawLineSDL(sx - diag, sy + diag, sx + diag, sy - diag, lightGold);
    }
    if (player)
    {
        player->Draw(*primitiveRenderer, camera);
    }



    SDL_RenderPresent(renderer);
}

void Engine::DrawVictoryText()
{
    const float vw = static_cast<float>(camera.GetViewportWidth());

    // ciemny panel pod tekstem, zeby bylo go widac na kafelkach
    SDL_SetRenderDrawBlendMode(renderer, SDL_BLENDMODE_BLEND);
    SDL_SetRenderDrawColor(renderer, 0, 0, 0, 170);
    SDL_FRect panel{vw / 2.0f - 450.0f, 70.0f, 900.0f, 180.0f};
    SDL_RenderFillRect(renderer, &panel);

    auto centered = [&](const std::string& text, float y, float scale,
                        Uint8 r, Uint8 g, Uint8 b) {
        SDL_SetRenderDrawColor(renderer, r, g, b, 255);
        SDL_SetRenderScale(renderer, scale, scale);
        float x = (vw / scale - text.size() * 8.0f) / 2.0f;   // znak = 8 px
        SDL_RenderDebugText(renderer, x, y / scale, text.c_str());
        SDL_SetRenderScale(renderer, 1.0f, 1.0f);
    };

    centered("MISSION COMPLETE", 100.0f, 6.0f, 50, 255, 150);
    centered("Stars collected: " + std::to_string(starsCollected) + "/3",
             170.0f, 3.0f, 255, 215, 0);
    centered("Press ESC to exit", 215.0f, 2.0f, 255, 255, 255);
}

void Engine::ClearScreen(
    Uint8 r,
    Uint8 g,
    Uint8 b,
    Uint8 a)
{
    SDL_SetRenderDrawColor(
        renderer,
        r, g, b, a);

    SDL_RenderClear(renderer);
}

void Engine::Run()
{
    if (fps <= 0)
        fps = 60;

    Uint32 frameDelay = 1000 / fps;

    while (running)
    {
        Uint32 frameStart =
            SDL_GetTicks();

        timer.Tick();

        ProcessEvents();

        Update(timer.GetDT());

        Render();
        input.EndFrame();

        Uint32 frameTime =
            SDL_GetTicks() - frameStart;

        if (frameTime < frameDelay)
        {
            SDL_Delay(
                frameDelay - frameTime);
        }
    }
}

void Engine::Shutdown()
{
    if (player) {
        delete player;
        player = nullptr;
    }
    if (primitiveRenderer)
    {
        delete primitiveRenderer;
        primitiveRenderer = nullptr;
    }

    if (renderer)
    {
        SDL_DestroyRenderer(renderer);
        renderer = nullptr;
    }

    if (window)
    {
        SDL_DestroyWindow(window);
        window = nullptr;
    }

    SDL_Quit();
    Log::Shutdown();
}
```

```cpp
#include "core/object_hierarchy.h"
#include "graphics/point2D.h"
#include "graphics/primitiverenderer.h"
#include <cmath>

BitmapObject::BitmapObject() : position(new Point2D(0.0f, 0.0f)), rotationAngle(0.0f), scaleFactor(1.0f){}
BitmapObject::BitmapObject(float x, float y) : position(new Point2D(x, y)), rotationAngle(0.0f), scaleFactor(1.0f) {}
BitmapObject::~BitmapObject(){
    delete position;
    position = nullptr;
}
BitmapObject::BitmapObject(BitmapObject&& other) noexcept
    : position(other.position),
      rotationAngle(other.rotationAngle),
      scaleFactor(other.scaleFactor),
      scaleFactorY(other.scaleFactorY),
      bitmaps(std::move(other.bitmaps))
{
    other.position = nullptr;
    other.rotationAngle = 0.0f;
    other.scaleFactor = 1.0f;
    other.scaleFactorY = 1.0f;
}

BitmapObject& BitmapObject::operator=(BitmapObject&& other) noexcept
{
    if (this != &other)
    {
        delete position;

        position = other.position;
        rotationAngle = other.rotationAngle;
        scaleFactor = other.scaleFactor;
        scaleFactorY = other.scaleFactorY;
        bitmaps = std::move(other.bitmaps);

        other.position = nullptr;
        other.rotationAngle = 0.0f;
        other.scaleFactor = 1.0f;
        other.scaleFactorY = 1.0f;
    }
    return *this;
}

float BitmapObject::GetX() const
{
    return position ? position->GetX() : 0.0f;
}

float BitmapObject::GetY() const
{
    return position ? position->GetY() : 0.0f;
}

void BitmapObject::AddBitmap(const BitmapHandler* bitmap) {
    if (bitmap) {
        bitmaps.push_back(bitmap);
    }
}

void BitmapObject::Translate(float tx, float ty) {
    if (position) {
        position->Translate(tx,ty);
    }
}

void BitmapObject::Rotate(float alpha) {
    rotationAngle += alpha;
}

void BitmapObject::Rotate(float alpha,const Point2D& center) {
    if (position) {
        position->Rotate(alpha, center);
    }
    rotationAngle += alpha;
}

void BitmapObject::Scale(float kx, float ky) {
    scaleFactor *= kx;
    scaleFactorY *= ky;
}

void BitmapObject::Scale(float kx, float ky, const Point2D& center) {
    if (position) {
        position->Scale(kx, ky, center);
    }
    scaleFactor *= kx;
    scaleFactorY *= ky;
}

void BitmapObject::Draw(PrimitiveRenderer& renderer) {
    float angleDeg = rotationAngle * (180.0f / 3.1415926535f);

    for (const auto* bmp : bitmaps)
    {
        if (bmp)
        {
            renderer.DrawBitmap(*bmp, position->GetX(), position->GetY(), scaleFactor, scaleFactorY, angleDeg);
        }
    }
}

bool SpriteObject::SetAnimation(std::size_t first, std::size_t count) {
    if (count == 0 || first >= bitmaps.size() || count > bitmaps.size() - first)
        return false;
    if (firstFrame != first || frameCount != count) {
        firstFrame = first;
        frameCount = count;
        currentFrame = 0;
        elapsed = 0.0f;
    }
    return true;
}

void SpriteObject::SetAnimating(bool enabled) {
    animating = enabled;
    if (!enabled) {
        currentFrame = 0;
        elapsed = 0.0f;
    }
}

void SpriteObject::Animate(float deltaTime) {
    if (!animating || frameCount == 0 || !std::isfinite(deltaTime) || deltaTime <= 0.0f)
        return;
    const double total = static_cast<double>(elapsed) + deltaTime;
    const double steps = std::floor(total / frameDuration);
    elapsed = static_cast<float>(std::fmod(total, frameDuration));
    currentFrame = static_cast<std::size_t>(std::fmod(currentFrame + steps, frameCount));
}

void SpriteObject::Draw(PrimitiveRenderer& renderer) {
    if (frameCount == 0)
        return;
    const auto* bitmap = bitmaps[firstFrame + currentFrame];
    if (bitmap) {
        const float angleDeg = rotationAngle * (180.0f / 3.1415926535f);
        renderer.DrawBitmap(*bitmap, position->GetX(), position->GetY(), scaleFactor, scaleFactorY, angleDeg);
    }
}

void SpriteObject::Draw(PrimitiveRenderer& renderer, const Camera& camera) {
    if (frameCount == 0 || !position)
        return;

    const auto* bitmap = bitmaps[firstFrame + currentFrame];
    if (bitmap) {
        const float angleDeg = rotationAngle * (180.0f / 3.1415926535f);
        float screenX = camera.WorldToScreenX(position->GetX());
        float screenY = camera.WorldToScreenY(position->GetY());

        renderer.DrawBitmap(*bitmap, screenX, screenY, scaleFactor, scaleFactorY, angleDeg);
    }
}
```

```cpp
#include "Timer.h"
#include <SDL3/SDL.h>

Timer::Timer()
{
    lastTime = SDL_GetPerformanceCounter();
    deltaTime = 0.0f;
    fps = 0.0f;
}

void Timer::Tick() {
    Uint64 currentTime = SDL_GetPerformanceCounter();
    Uint64 frequency = SDL_GetPerformanceFrequency();

    deltaTime = static_cast<float>(currentTime - lastTime) / static_cast<float>(frequency);

    lastTime = currentTime;

    if (deltaTime > 0.05f) {
        deltaTime = 0.05f;
    }

    if (deltaTime > 0.0f)
    {
        fps = 1.0f / deltaTime;
    }
}

float Timer::GetDT() const{
    return deltaTime;
}

float Timer::GetFPS() const {
    return fps;
}
```

```cpp
void Player::Update(float deltaTime, const Tilemap& map) {
    float vx = 0.0f;
    float vy = 0.0f;

    if (input.IsKeyDown(SDL_SCANCODE_W) || input.IsKeyDown(SDL_SCANCODE_UP))    vy -= speed;
    if (input.IsKeyDown(SDL_SCANCODE_S) || input.IsKeyDown(SDL_SCANCODE_DOWN))  vy += speed;
    if (input.IsKeyDown(SDL_SCANCODE_A) || input.IsKeyDown(SDL_SCANCODE_LEFT))  vx -= speed;
    if (input.IsKeyDown(SDL_SCANCODE_D) || input.IsKeyDown(SDL_SCANCODE_RIGHT)) vx += speed;

    if (vx != 0.0f && vy != 0.0f) {
        vx *= 0.70710678f;
        vy *= 0.70710678f;
    }

    float dx = vx * deltaTime;
    float dy = vy * deltaTime;

    const int tSize = map.GetTileSize();

    if (dx != 0.0f) {
        Translate(dx, 0.0f);
        AABB box = GetCollider();
        float halfW = box.w / 2.0f;
        int startTileX = static_cast<int>(std::floor(box.x / tSize));
        int endTileX   = static_cast<int>(std::floor((box.x + box.w - 0.01f) / tSize));
        int startTileY = static_cast<int>(std::floor(box.y / tSize));
        int endTileY   = static_cast<int>(std::floor((box.y + box.h - 0.01f) / tSize));

        for (int ty = startTileY; ty <= endTileY; ++ty) {
            for (int tx = startTileX; tx <= endTileX; ++tx) {
                if (map.IsSolidAtTile(tx, ty)) {
                    AABB tileBox(static_cast<float>(tx * tSize), static_cast<float>(ty * tSize),
                                 static_cast<float>(tSize), static_cast<float>(tSize));
                    if (box.Intersects(tileBox)) {
                        if (dx > 0.0f) {
                            SetPosition(tileBox.x - halfW, GetY());
                        } else if (dx < 0.0f) {
                            SetPosition(tileBox.x + tileBox.w + halfW, GetY());
                        }
                        box = GetCollider();
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if (dy != 0.0f) {
        Translate(0.0f, dy);
        AABB box = GetCollider();
        float halfH = box.h / 2.0f;
        int startTileX = static_cast<int>(std::floor(box.x / tSize));
        int endTileX   = static_cast<int>(std::floor((box.x + box.w - 0.01f) / tSize));
        int startTileY = static_cast<int>(std::floor(box.y / tSize));
        int endTileY   = static_cast<int>(std::floor((box.y + box.h - 0.01f) / tSize));

        for (int ty = startTileY; ty <= endTileY; ++ty) {
            for (int tx = startTileX; tx <= endTileX; ++tx) {
                if (map.IsSolidAtTile(tx, ty)) {
                    AABB tileBox(static_cast<float>(tx * tSize), static_cast<float>(ty * tSize),
                                 static_cast<float>(tSize), static_cast<float>(tSize));
                    if (box.Intersects(tileBox)) {
                        if (dy > 0.0f) {
                            SetPosition(GetX(), tileBox.y - halfH);
                        } else if (dy < 0.0f) {
                            SetPosition(GetX(), tileBox.y + tileBox.h + halfH);
                        }
                        box = GetCollider();
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if (dx != 0.0f || dy != 0.0f) {
        const int row = dy < 0.0f ? 3 : dy > 0.0f ? 0 : dx < 0.0f ? 1 : 2;
        SetAnimation(row * 4, 4);
        SetAnimating(true);
        Animate(deltaTime);
    } else {
        SetAnimating(false);
    }

    float rotSpeed = 3.0f;
    if (input.IsKeyDown(SDL_SCANCODE_Q)) Rotate(-rotSpeed * deltaTime);
    if (input.IsKeyDown(SDL_SCANCODE_E)) Rotate(rotSpeed * deltaTime);

    float scaleSpeed = 1.0f;
    if (input.IsKeyDown(SDL_SCANCODE_R)) Scale(1.0f + scaleSpeed * deltaTime, 1.0f + scaleSpeed * deltaTime);
    if (input.IsKeyDown(SDL_SCANCODE_F)) Scale(1.0f - scaleSpeed * deltaTime, 1.0f - scaleSpeed * deltaTime);
}
```

```cpp
#include "graphics/bitmap_handler.h"
#include <iostream>

namespace {
bool Contains(SDL_Surface* surface, const SDL_Rect& area) {
    return surface && area.x >= 0 && area.y >= 0 && area.w > 0 && area.h > 0 &&
           area.w <= surface->w && area.h <= surface->h &&
           area.x <= (surface->w - area.w) &&
           area.y <= (surface->h - area.h);
}
}

BitmapHandler::BitmapHandler(int width, int height) {
    create_bitmap(width, height);
};
BitmapHandler::BitmapHandler(const std::string& filepath)
{
    load_from_file(filepath);
}
BitmapHandler::~BitmapHandler()
{
    delete_bitmap();
}
BitmapHandler::BitmapHandler(BitmapHandler&& other) noexcept : surface(other.surface)
{
    other.surface = nullptr;
}
BitmapHandler& BitmapHandler::operator=(BitmapHandler&& other) noexcept
{
    if (this != &other)
    {
        delete_bitmap();
        surface = other.surface;
        other.surface = nullptr;
    }
    return *this;
}
bool BitmapHandler::create_bitmap(int width, int height) {
    delete_bitmap();
    if (width <= 0 || height <= 0) {
        return false;
    }
    surface = SDL_CreateSurface(width, height, SDL_PIXELFORMAT_RGBA32);
    if (surface && !SDL_FillSurfaceRect(surface, nullptr, SDL_MapSurfaceRGBA(surface, 0, 0, 0, 0))) {
        delete_bitmap();
    }
    return surface != nullptr;
};
void BitmapHandler::delete_bitmap() {
    if (surface) {
        SDL_DestroySurface(surface);
        surface = nullptr;
    }
}

bool BitmapHandler::load_from_file(const std::string& filepath) {
    delete_bitmap();
    surface = SDL_LoadBMP(filepath.c_str());
    return surface != nullptr;
}

bool BitmapHandler::save_to_file(const std::string& filepath) {
    if (!surface) {
        return false;
    }
    return SDL_SaveBMP(surface, filepath.c_str());
}
bool BitmapHandler::copy_bitmap(const BitmapHandler& source, const SDL_Rect* srcRect, const SDL_Rect* dstRect) {
    if (!surface || !source.surface) {
        return false;
    }
    const SDL_Rect from = srcRect ? *srcRect : SDL_Rect{0, 0, source.surface->w, source.surface->h};
    const SDL_Rect to = dstRect ? *dstRect : SDL_Rect{0, 0, from.w, from.h};
    if (!Contains(source.surface, from) || !Contains(surface, to) || from.w != to.w || from.h != to.h)
        return false;
    if (surface == source.surface) {
        BitmapHandler temporary(from.w, from.h);
        return temporary.copy_bitmap(source, &from) && copy_bitmap(temporary, nullptr, &to);
    }
    SDL_BlendMode previous;
    if (!SDL_GetSurfaceBlendMode(source.surface, &previous) ||
        !SDL_SetSurfaceBlendMode(source.surface, SDL_BLENDMODE_NONE))
        return false;
    const bool copied = SDL_BlitSurface(source.surface, &from, surface, &to);
    SDL_SetSurfaceBlendMode(source.surface, previous);
    return copied;
}
bool BitmapHandler::LoadFragment(const std::string& filepath, const SDL_Rect& sourceRect) {
    BitmapHandler fullImage(filepath);
    if (!Contains(fullImage.surface, sourceRect)) {
        return false;
    }
    if (!create_bitmap(sourceRect.w, sourceRect.h)) {
        return false;
    }
    SDL_Rect dest = {0,0, sourceRect.w, sourceRect.h};
    return copy_bitmap(fullImage, &sourceRect, &dest);
}

bool BitmapHandler::SaveFragment(const std::string&filepath, const SDL_Rect& area) const{
    if (!Contains(surface, area)) {
        return false;
    }
    BitmapHandler cropped(area.w, area.h);
    if (!cropped.isValid()) {
        return false;
    }
    SDL_Rect dest = {0,0, area.w, area.h};
    if (!cropped.copy_bitmap(*this, &area, &dest)) {
        return false;
    }
    return cropped.save_to_file(filepath);
};
```

```cpp
float LineSegment::Orientation(const Point2D& a, const Point2D& b, const Point2D& c)
{
    return (b.GetX() - a.GetX()) * (c.GetY() - a.GetY()) -
           (b.GetY() - a.GetY()) * (c.GetX() - a.GetX());
}

bool LineSegment::OnSegment(const Point2D& p, const Point2D& q, const Point2D& r)
{
    return q.GetX() <= std::max(p.GetX(), r.GetX()) && q.GetX() >= std::min(p.GetX(), r.GetX()) &&
           q.GetY() <= std::max(p.GetY(), r.GetY()) && q.GetY() >= std::min(p.GetY(), r.GetY());
}

bool LineSegment::DoIntersect(const Point2D& p1, const Point2D& q1, const Point2D& p2, const Point2D& q2)
{
    float d1 = Orientation(p1, q1, p2);
    float d2 = Orientation(p1, q1, q2);
    float d3 = Orientation(p2, q2, p1);
    float d4 = Orientation(p2, q2, q1);

    if (((d1 > 0 && d2 < 0) || (d1 < 0 && d2 > 0)) &&
        ((d3 > 0 && d4 < 0) || (d3 < 0 && d4 > 0)))
    {
        return true;
    }

    if (d1 == 0 && OnSegment(p1, p2, q1)) return true;
    if (d2 == 0 && OnSegment(p1, q2, q1)) return true;
    if (d3 == 0 && OnSegment(p2, p1, q2)) return true;
    if (d4 == 0 && OnSegment(p2, q1, q2)) return true;

    return false;
}
```

```cpp
void Point2D::Rotate(float alpha)
{
    float cosA = std::cos(alpha);
    float sinA = std::sin(alpha);
    float newX = x * cosA - y * sinA;
    float newY = x * sinA + y * cosA;
    x = newX;
    y = newY;
}

void Point2D::Rotate(float alpha, const Point2D& center)
{
    float cosA = std::cos(alpha);
    float sinA = std::sin(alpha);
    float dx = x - center.GetX();
    float dy = y - center.GetY();

    x = center.GetX() + (dx * cosA - dy * sinA);
    y = center.GetY() + (dx * sinA + dy * cosA);
}

void Point2D::Scale(float kx, float ky)
{
    x *= kx;
    y *= ky;
}

void Point2D::Scale(float kx, float ky, const Point2D& center)
{
    x = center.GetX() + (x - center.GetX()) * kx;
    y = center.GetY() + (y - center.GetY()) * ky;
}
```

```cpp
#include "PrimitiveRenderer.h"
#include<math.h>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <queue>
#include "../../include/graphics/bitmap_handler.h"
PrimitiveRenderer::PrimitiveRenderer(SDL_Renderer* r)
{
    renderer = r;
}
PrimitiveRenderer::~PrimitiveRenderer() {
    for (auto& [surface, texture] : textureCache) {
        if (texture) {
            SDL_DestroyTexture(texture);
        }
    }
    textureCache.clear();
}
SDL_Texture* PrimitiveRenderer::GetOrCreateTexture(SDL_Surface* surface) {
    if (!renderer || !surface) {
        return nullptr;
    }

    auto it = textureCache.find(surface);
    if (it != textureCache.end()) {
        return it->second;
    }

    SDL_Texture* texture = SDL_CreateTextureFromSurface(renderer, surface);
    if (texture) {
        SDL_SetTextureBlendMode(texture, SDL_BLENDMODE_BLEND);
        SDL_SetTextureScaleMode(texture, SDL_SCALEMODE_NEAREST);
        textureCache[surface] = texture;
    }
    return texture;
}
SDL_Color PrimitiveRenderer::GetPixelColor(SDL_Surface* surface, int x, int y)
{
    if (!surface || x < 0 || x >= surface->w || y < 0 || y >= surface->h)
    {
        return SDL_Color{0, 0, 0, 0};
    }

    const Uint8* pixelAddress = static_cast<const Uint8*>(surface->pixels)
                                + y * surface->pitch
                                + x * SDL_BYTESPERPIXEL(surface->format);

    Uint32 pixelValue = 0;
    int bpp = SDL_BYTESPERPIXEL(surface->format);

    switch (bpp)
    {
        case 1:
            pixelValue = *pixelAddress;
            break;
        case 2:
            pixelValue = *reinterpret_cast<const Uint16*>(pixelAddress);
            break;
        case 3:
            if (SDL_BYTEORDER == SDL_BIG_ENDIAN)
                pixelValue = (pixelAddress[0] << 16) | (pixelAddress[1] << 8) | pixelAddress[2];
            else
                pixelValue = pixelAddress[0] | (pixelAddress[1] << 8) | (pixelAddress[2] << 16);
            break;
        case 4:
            pixelValue = *reinterpret_cast<const Uint32*>(pixelAddress);
            break;
        default:
            return SDL_Color{0, 0, 0, 0};
    }

    SDL_Color color;
    const SDL_PixelFormatDetails* details = SDL_GetPixelFormatDetails(surface->format);
    SDL_GetRGBA(pixelValue, details, nullptr, &color.r, &color.g, &color.b, &color.a);

    return color;
}

void PrimitiveRenderer::SetPixelColor(SDL_Surface* surface, int x, int y, SDL_Color color)
{
    if (!surface || x < 0 || x >= surface->w || y < 0 || y >= surface->h)
        return;

    Uint8* pixelAddress = static_cast<Uint8*>(surface->pixels)
                          + y * surface->pitch
                          + x * SDL_BYTESPERPIXEL(surface->format);

    const SDL_PixelFormatDetails* details = SDL_GetPixelFormatDetails(surface->format);
    Uint32 pixelValue = SDL_MapRGBA(details, nullptr, color.r, color.g, color.b, color.a);

    int bpp = SDL_BYTESPERPIXEL(surface->format);
    switch (bpp)
    {
        case 1:
            *pixelAddress = static_cast<Uint8>(pixelValue);
            break;
        case 2:
            *reinterpret_cast<Uint16*>(pixelAddress) = static_cast<Uint16>(pixelValue);
            break;
        case 3:
            if (SDL_BYTEORDER == SDL_BIG_ENDIAN) {
                pixelAddress[0] = (pixelValue >> 16) & 0xFF;
                pixelAddress[1] = (pixelValue >> 8) & 0xFF;
                pixelAddress[2] = pixelValue & 0xFF;
            } else {
                pixelAddress[0] = pixelValue & 0xFF;
                pixelAddress[1] = (pixelValue >> 8) & 0xFF;
                pixelAddress[2] = (pixelValue >> 16) & 0xFF;
            }
            break;
        case 4:
            *reinterpret_cast<Uint32*>(pixelAddress) = pixelValue;
            break;
    }
}
bool PrimitiveRenderer::ColorsMatch(const SDL_Color& c1, const SDL_Color& c2) {
    return c1.r == c2.r &&
           c1.g == c2.g &&
           c1.b == c2.b &&
           c1.a == c2.a;
}

void PrimitiveRenderer::DrawLineSDL(
    float x1,
    float y1,
    float x2,
    float y2,
    SDL_Color color)
{
    SDL_SetRenderDrawColor(
        renderer,
        color.r,
        color.g,
        color.b,
        color.a);

    SDL_RenderLine(
        renderer,
        x1,
        y1,
        x2,
        y2);
}

void PrimitiveRenderer::DrawLineIncremental(
    float x1,
    float y1,
    float x2,
    float y2,
    SDL_Color color)
{
    SDL_SetRenderDrawColor(
        renderer,
        color.r,
        color.g,
        color.b,
        color.a);

    float dx = x2 - x1;
    float dy = y2 - y1;

    if (dx == 0.0f)
    {
        if (y1 > y2)
            std::swap(y1, y2);

        for (float y = y1; y <= y2; y += 1.0f)
        {
            SDL_RenderPoint(
                renderer,
                x1,
                y);
        }

        return;
    }

    float m = dy / dx;

    if (std::abs(m) <= 1.0f)
    {
        if (x1 > x2)
        {
            std::swap(x1, x2);
            std::swap(y1, y2);
        }

        float y = y1;

        for (float x = x1; x <= x2; x += 1.0f)
        {
            SDL_RenderPoint(
                renderer,
                std::round(x),
                std::round(y));

            y += m;
        }
    }
    else
    {
        if (y1 > y2)
        {
            std::swap(x1, x2);
            std::swap(y1, y2);
        }

        float mInv = dx / dy;
        float x = x1;

        for (float y = y1; y <= y2; y += 1.0f)
        {
            SDL_RenderPoint(
                renderer,
                std::round(x),
                std::round(y));

            x += mInv;
        }
    }
}

void PrimitiveRenderer::DrawPolilane(const std::vector<Point2D>& points, bool isClosed, SDL_Color color) {
    if (points.size() < 2)
    {
        return;
    }

    for (size_t i = 0; i < points.size() - 1; ++i)
    {
        DrawLineSDL(
            points[i].GetX(),
            points[i].GetY(),
            points[i + 1].GetX(),
            points[i + 1].GetY(),
            color
        );
    }

    if (isClosed)
    {
        DrawLineSDL(
            points.back().GetX(),
            points.back().GetY(),
            points.front().GetX(),
            points.front().GetY(),
            color
        );
    }
};

void PrimitiveRenderer::DrawPolygon(const std::vector<Point2D>& points, SDL_Color color) {
    size_t n = points.size();

    if (n < 3)
    {
        return;
    }

    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i)
    {
        Point2D p1 = points[i];
        Point2D q1 = points[(i + 1) % n];

        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j)
        {
            if (j == (i + 1) % n) continue;
            if (i == 0 && j == n - 1) continue;

            Point2D p2 = points[j];
            Point2D q2 = points[(j + 1) % n];

            if (LineSegment::DoIntersect(p1, q1, p2, q2))
            {
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    DrawPolilane(points, true, color);
}

void PrimitiveRenderer::DrawPoint(
    float x,
    float y,
    SDL_Color color)
{
    SDL_SetRenderDrawColor(
        renderer,
        color.r,

        color.b,

        y);
}
void PrimitiveRenderer::DrawCircle(float x0, float y0, int r, SDL_Color color)
{
    SDL_SetRenderDrawColor(
        renderer,
        color.r,
        color.g,
        color.b,
        color.a);
    const float PI = 3.1415926535f;

    for (float alpha = 0.0; alpha <= PI / 2.0; alpha += 0.01)
    {
        float dx = std::round(r * std::cos(alpha));
        float dy = std::round(r * std::sin(alpha));
        DrawPoint(x0 + dx,y0 + dy,color);
        DrawPoint(x0 - dx,y0 + dy,color);
        DrawPoint(x0-dx,y0 - dy,color);
        DrawPoint(x0+dx,y0-dy,color);
    }
}
void PrimitiveRenderer::DrawFilledCircle(float x0, float y0, int r, SDL_Color color)
{
    SDL_SetRenderDrawColor(renderer, color.r, color.g, color.b, color.a);
    const float PI = 3.1415926535f;
    float step = (r > 0) ? (1.0f / static_cast<float>(r)) : 0.01f;

    for (float alpha = 0.0f; alpha <= PI / 2.0f; alpha += step)
    {
        float dx = std::round(r * std::cos(alpha));
        float dy = std::round(r * std::sin(alpha));

        DrawLineSDL(x0 - dx, y0 + dy, x0 + dx, y0 + dy, color);
        DrawLineSDL(x0 - dx, y0 - dy, x0 + dx, y0 - dy, color);
    }
}
void PrimitiveRenderer::DrawElipse(float x0, float y0, int  r_x, int r_y, SDL_Color color) {
    SDL_SetRenderDrawColor(
        renderer,
        color.r,
        color.g,
        color.b,
        color.a);
    const float PI = 3.1415926535f;

    for (float alpha = 0.0; alpha <= PI / 2.0; alpha += 0.01) {
        float dx = std::round(r_x * std::cos(alpha));
        float dy = std::round(r_y * std::sin(alpha));
        DrawPoint(x0 + dx,y0 + dy,color);
        DrawPoint(x0 - dx,y0 + dy,color);
        DrawPoint(x0-dx,y0 - dy,color);
        DrawPoint(x0+dx,y0-dy,color);
    }
}
void PrimitiveRenderer::DrawFilledEllipse(float x0, float y0, int r_x, int r_y, SDL_Color color)
{
    SDL_SetRenderDrawColor(renderer, color.r, color.g, color.b, color.a);
    const float PI = 3.1415926535f;
    int maxR = std::max(r_x, r_y);
    float step = (maxR > 0) ? (1.0f / static_cast<float>(maxR)) : 0.01f;

    for (float alpha = 0.0f; alpha <= PI / 2.0f; alpha += step)
    {
        float dx = std::round(r_x * std::cos(alpha));
        float dy = std::round(r_y * std::sin(alpha));

        DrawLineSDL(x0 - dx, y0 + dy, x0 + dx, y0 + dy, color);
        DrawLineSDL(x0 - dx, y0 - dy, x0 + dx, y0 - dy, color);
    }
}
void PrimitiveRenderer::BoundaryFill(Point2D seed, SDL_Color fillColor, SDL_Color boundaryColor) {
    int w = 0, h = 0;
    SDL_GetCurrentRenderOutputSize(renderer, &w, &h);
    if (ColorsMatch(fillColor, boundaryColor)) return;
    SDL_Surface* snapshot = SDL_RenderReadPixels(renderer, nullptr);
    if (!snapshot) return;
    std::queue<Point2D> q;
    q.push(seed);
    while (!q.empty())
    {
        Point2D p = q.front();
        q.pop();

        int x = static_cast<int>(p.GetX());
        int y = static_cast<int>(p.GetY());
        if (x < 0 || x >= snapshot->w || y < 0 || y >= snapshot->h)
            continue;

        SDL_Color current = GetPixelColor(snapshot,x, y);

        if (ColorsMatch(current, fillColor) || ColorsMatch(current, boundaryColor))
            continue;

        DrawPoint(x, y, fillColor);
        SetPixelColor(snapshot, x, y, fillColor);
        q.emplace(x, y - 1);
        q.emplace(x, y + 1);
        q.emplace(x - 1, y);
        q.emplace(x + 1, y);
    }
    SDL_DestroySurface(snapshot);
}

void PrimitiveRenderer::FloodFill(Point2D seed, SDL_Color fillColor, SDL_Color backgroundColor) {
    int w = 0, h = 0;
    SDL_GetCurrentRenderOutputSize(renderer, &w, &h);
    if (ColorsMatch(fillColor, backgroundColor)) return;
    SDL_Surface* snapshot = SDL_RenderReadPixels(renderer, nullptr);
    if (!snapshot) return;
    std::queue<Point2D> q;
    q.push(seed);
    while (!q.empty())
    {
        Point2D p = q.front();
        q.pop();

        int x = static_cast<int>(p.GetX());
        int y = static_cast<int>(p.GetY());
        if (x < 0 || x >= snapshot->w || y < 0 || y >= snapshot->h)
            continue;

        SDL_Color current = GetPixelColor(snapshot,x, y);

        if (ColorsMatch(current, fillColor) || !ColorsMatch(current, backgroundColor))
            continue;

        DrawPoint(x, y, fillColor);
        SetPixelColor(snapshot, x, y, fillColor);
        q.emplace(x, y - 1);
        q.emplace(x, y + 1);
        q.emplace(x - 1, y);
        q.emplace(x + 1, y);
    }
    SDL_DestroySurface(snapshot);
}
void PrimitiveRenderer::DrawBitmap(const BitmapHandler& bitmap, float x, float y, float scale, float angleDeg)
{
    DrawBitmap(bitmap, x, y, scale, scale, angleDeg);
}

void PrimitiveRenderer::DrawBitmap(const BitmapHandler& bitmap, float x, float y, float scaleX, float scaleY, float angleDeg)
{
    if (!renderer || !bitmap.isValid())
        return;

    SDL_Texture* texture = GetOrCreateTexture(bitmap.GetRawSurface());
    if (!texture)
        return;

    float w = bitmap.GetWidth() * std::abs(scaleX);
    float h = bitmap.GetHeight() * std::abs(scaleY);

    SDL_FRect dstRect = {
        x - w / 2.0f,
        y - h / 2.0f,
        w,
        h
    };

    const auto flip = static_cast<SDL_FlipMode>((scaleX < 0 ? SDL_FLIP_HORIZONTAL : 0) |
                                               (scaleY < 0 ? SDL_FLIP_VERTICAL : 0));
    SDL_RenderTextureRotated(renderer, texture, nullptr, &dstRect, angleDeg, nullptr, flip);

}

void PrimitiveRenderer::DrawBitmapFragment(const BitmapHandler& bitmap, const SDL_Rect& srcRect, float x, float y, float scale, float angleDeg)
{
    if (!renderer || !bitmap.isValid())
        return;

    SDL_Surface* surf = bitmap.GetRawSurface();

    auto it = textureCache.find(surf);
    SDL_Texture* texture = nullptr;

    if (it != textureCache.end()) {
        texture = it->second;
    } else {
        texture = SDL_CreateTextureFromSurface(renderer, surf);
        if (!texture) return;

        SDL_SetTextureBlendMode(texture, SDL_BLENDMODE_BLEND);
        SDL_SetTextureScaleMode(texture, SDL_SCALEMODE_NEAREST);
        textureCache[surf] = texture;
    }

    SDL_FRect fSrcRect = {
        static_cast<float>(srcRect.x),
        static_cast<float>(srcRect.y),
        static_cast<float>(srcRect.w),
        static_cast<float>(srcRect.h)
    };

    float w = fSrcRect.w * scale;
    float h = fSrcRect.h * scale;

    SDL_FRect dstRect = { x, y, w, h };

    SDL_RenderTextureRotated(renderer, texture, &fSrcRect, &dstRect, angleDeg, nullptr, SDL_FLIP_NONE);
}
```

```cpp
#include "Input.h"

void Input::HandleEvent(const SDL_Event& event)
{
    switch (event.type)
    {
        case SDL_EVENT_KEY_DOWN:
            if (event.key.scancode < SDL_SCANCODE_COUNT)
                keys[event.key.scancode] = true;
            break;

        case SDL_EVENT_KEY_UP:
            if (event.key.scancode < SDL_SCANCODE_COUNT)
                keys[event.key.scancode] = false;
            break;

        case SDL_EVENT_MOUSE_BUTTON_DOWN:
            if (event.button.button < 8)
                mouseButtons[event.button.button] = true;
            break;

        case SDL_EVENT_MOUSE_BUTTON_UP:
            if (event.button.button < 8)
                mouseButtons[event.button.button] = false;
            break;

        case SDL_EVENT_MOUSE_MOTION:
            mouseX = event.motion.x;
            mouseY = event.motion.y;
            break;

        case SDL_EVENT_MOUSE_WHEEL:
            wheelY = event.wheel.y;
            break;

        default:
            break;
    }
}

void Input::EndFrame()
{
    wheelY = 0.0f;
}

bool Input::IsKeyDown(SDL_Scancode scancode) const
{
    if (scancode < SDL_SCANCODE_COUNT)
        return keys[scancode];
    return false;
}

bool Input::IsMouseButtonDown(Uint8 button) const
{
    if (button < 8)
        return mouseButtons[button];
    return false;
}

void Input::GetMousePos(float& x, float& y) const
{
    x = mouseX;
    y = mouseY;
}

float Input::GetMouseWheel() const
{
    return wheelY;
}
```

```cpp
#include "logs.h"
#include <iostream>
#include <SDL3/SDL.h>

std::ofstream Log::logFile;

bool Log::Init(std::string_view filename)
{
    logFile.open(filename.data(), std::ios::out | std::ios::trunc);
    if (!logFile.is_open())
    {
        std::cerr << "[ERROR] Nie udalo sie otworzyc pliku logow: " << filename << '\n';
        return false;
    }

    Info("System logowania zostal uruchomiony.");
    return true;
}

void Log::Shutdown()
{
    if (logFile.is_open())
    {
        Info("System logowania zakonczyl prace.");
        logFile.close();
    }
}

void Log::Write(LogLevel level, std::string_view msg)
{
    const char* prefix = "[INFO] ";
    if (level == LogLevel::Warning) prefix = "[WARN] ";
    if (level == LogLevel::Error)   prefix = "[ERROR] ";
    if (level == LogLevel::Error)
        std::cerr << prefix << msg << '\n';
    else
        std::cout << prefix << msg << '\n';

    if (logFile.is_open())
    {
        logFile << prefix << msg << '\n';
        logFile.flush();
    }
}

void Log::Info(std::string_view msg)
{
    Write(LogLevel::Info, msg);
}

void Log::Warn(std::string_view msg)
{
    Write(LogLevel::Warning, msg);
}

void Log::Error(std::string_view msg)
{
    Write(LogLevel::Error, msg);
}

void Log::SDLError(std::string_view action)
{
    std::string fullMsg = std::string(action) + " -> SDL: " + SDL_GetError();
    Write(LogLevel::Error, fullMsg);
}
```

```cpp
#include "world/tilemap.h"
#include "graphics/bitmap_handler.h"
#include "graphics/primitiverenderer.h"
#include "graphics/camera.h"
#include <cmath>
#include <fstream>
#include <limits>
#include <utility>

Tilemap::Tilemap(int width, int height, int tileSize, const BitmapHandler* tilesetBitmap)
    : mapWidth(width), mapHeight(height), tileSize(tileSize), tileset(tilesetBitmap)
{
    tiles.resize(width * height, 0);
}
void Tilemap::SetTiles(const std::vector<int>& new_tiles, int width, int height) {
    mapWidth = width;
    mapHeight = height;
    tiles = new_tiles;
}

bool Tilemap::LoadFromFile(const std::string& path, const BitmapHandler* tilesetBitmap) {
    if (!tilesetBitmap || !tilesetBitmap->isValid())
        return false;

    std::ifstream file(path);
    int width, height, size, solidStart;
    if (!(file >> width >> height >> size >> solidStart))
        return false;
    if (width <= 0 || height <= 0 || width > 4096 || height > 4096 ||
        static_cast<long long>(width) * height > 4194304 || size <= 0 ||
        size > tilesetBitmap->GetWidth() || size > tilesetBitmap->GetHeight() ||
        tilesetBitmap->GetWidth() % size != 0 || tilesetBitmap->GetHeight() % size != 0 ||
        width > std::numeric_limits<int>::max() / size ||
        height > std::numeric_limits<int>::max() / size)
        return false;

    const long long atlasTileCount = static_cast<long long>(tilesetBitmap->GetWidth() / size) *
                                    (tilesetBitmap->GetHeight() / size);
    if (atlasTileCount > std::numeric_limits<int>::max() ||
        solidStart < 0 || solidStart > atlasTileCount)
        return false;

    std::vector<int> loadedTiles(width * height);
    for (int& id : loadedTiles) {
        if (!(file >> id) || id < 0 || id >= atlasTileCount)
            return false;
    }
    file >> std::ws;
    if (!file.eof())
        return false;

    mapWidth = width;
    mapHeight = height;
    tileSize = size;
    firstSolidTile = solidStart;
    tileset = tilesetBitmap;
    tiles = std::move(loadedTiles);
    return true;
}

bool Tilemap::isSolid(int tileX, int tileY) const{
    return IsSolidAtTile(tileX, tileY);
}

bool Tilemap::CheckCollision(float worldX, float worldY, float width, float height) const{
    if (!std::isfinite(worldX) || !std::isfinite(worldY) ||
        !std::isfinite(width) || !std::isfinite(height) ||
        width <= 0.0f || height <= 0.0f || tileSize <= 0 ||
        worldX < 0.0f || worldY < 0.0f ||
        worldX + width > GetWorldWidth() || worldY + height > GetWorldHeight())
        return true;
    int startCol = static_cast<int>(std::floor(worldX / tileSize));
    int endCol   = static_cast<int>(std::floor((worldX + width - 0.01f) / tileSize));
    int startRow = static_cast<int>(std::floor(worldY / tileSize));
    int endRow   = static_cast<int>(std::floor((worldY + height - 0.01f) / tileSize));
    for (int row = startRow; row <= endRow; ++row)
    {
        for (int col = startCol; col <= endCol; ++col)
        {
            if (isSolid(col, row))
            {
                return true;
            }
        }
    }
    return false;
}

void Tilemap::Draw(PrimitiveRenderer& renderer) {
    Camera cam(1920,1080);
    Draw(renderer, cam);
}
void Tilemap::Draw(PrimitiveRenderer& renderer, const Camera& camera)
{
    if (!tileset || !tileset->isValid())
        return;

    int tilesPerRow = tileset->GetWidth() / tileSize;
    if (tilesPerRow <= 0) return;

    for (int y = 0; y < mapHeight; ++y)
    {
        for (int x = 0; x < mapWidth; ++x)
        {
            int tileID = tiles[y * mapWidth + x];
            if (tileID < 0) continue;

            SDL_Rect srcRect;
            srcRect.x = (tileID % tilesPerRow) * tileSize;
            srcRect.y = (tileID / tilesPerRow) * tileSize;
            srcRect.w = tileSize;
            srcRect.h = tileSize;
            float worldX = static_cast<float>(x * tileSize);
            float worldY = static_cast<float>(y * tileSize);
            float screenX = (x * tileSize) - camera.GetX();
            float screenY = (y * tileSize) - camera.GetY();
            if (screenX + tileSize < 0 || screenX > camera.GetViewportWidth() ||
                screenY + tileSize < 0 || screenY > camera.GetViewportHeight())
            {
                continue;
            }
            renderer.DrawBitmapFragment(*tileset, srcRect, screenX, screenY);
        }
    }
}
```

```python
"""Generuje assets/victory.map - pokoj "Mission Complete" zlozony z kafelkow.

Format pliku jest taki sam jak w world.map:
    szerokosc wysokosc rozmiar_kafelka pierwszy_solidny_kafelek
a potem szerokosc*wysokosc numerow kafelkow (wiersz po wierszu).
Uzywamy tego samego tileset.bmp, wiec nie trzeba nowej grafiki.
"""
import random
import sys
from pathlib import Path

W, H, TILE = 60, 34, 32          # 60*32 = 1920, 34*32 = 1088 (ekran 1920x1080)
FIRST_SOLID = 598                # id >= 598 to sciana/przeszkoda (jak w world.map)

FLOOR = [164, 165, 166, 167, 168]  # kafelki podlogi z placu przy portalu
PEDESTAL = {                       # cokol portalu z world.map (solidny!)
    0: [None, 825, 826, 827, 828, None],
    1: [837, 838, 839, 840, 841, 842],
    2: [852, 853, 854, 855, 856, 857],
}
PED_X, PED_Y = 27, 12            # lewy gorny rog cokolu (w kafelkach)


def build():
    rng = random.Random(42)
    tiles = [[rng.choice(FLOOR) for _ in range(W)] for _ in range(H)]

    # ramka ze scian, 2 kafelki grubosci - te same wzory co w world.map
    for x in range(W):
        for y, base in ((0, 598), (1, 601), (H - 2, 598), (H - 1, 601)):
            tiles[y][x] = base + x % 3
    for y in range(2, H - 2):
        tiles[y][0] = 598 + y % 3
        tiles[y][1] = 601 + y % 3
        tiles[y][W - 2] = 598 + y % 3
        tiles[y][W - 1] = 601 + y % 3

    # cokol na srodku (solidny - gracz go obejdzie)
    for dy, row in PEDESTAL.items():
        for dx, tid in enumerate(row):
            if tid is not None:
                tiles[PED_Y + dy][PED_X + dx] = tid
    return tiles


def main():
    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
    out = Path(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else root / "assets" / "victory.map"
    tiles = build()
    lines = [f"{W} {H} {TILE} {FIRST_SOLID}"]
    lines += [" ".join(map(str, row)) for row in tiles]
    out.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n")

    # podglad w konsoli: # sciana/solid, . podloga
    for row in tiles:
        print("".join("#" if t >= FIRST_SOLID else "." for t in row))
    print(f"\nZapisano {out}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```python
    rng = random.Random(1705)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as source:
        sheets = {
            name: Image.open(io.BytesIO(source.read(name + ".png"))).convert("RGBA")
            for name in ("Grass", "Grass 2 layer", "Wall", "Plants", "Props")
        }

    reserved = [[False] * WIDTH for _ in range(HEIGHT)]

                patch = crop("Grass", 1, 0, 2, 2)
                if rng.choice((False, True)):
                    patch = patch.transpose(Image.Transpose.FLIP_LEFT_RIGHT)
                world.alpha_composite(patch, (x * TILE, y * TILE))

    for y in range(HEIGHT):
        for x in range(WIDTH):
            if rng.random() < 0.35:
                tuft = crop("Grass 2 layer", rng.randrange(4, 10), rng.choice((3, 4, 5, 6, 7)))
                world.alpha_composite(tuft, (x * TILE, y * TILE))

    def reserve(x, y, w, h, margin=0):
        for ty in range(max(0, y - margin), min(HEIGHT, y + h + margin)):
            for tx in range(max(0, x - margin), min(WIDTH, x + w + margin)):
                reserved[ty][tx] = True

    def stamp(sprite, x, y, solid=False):
        world.alpha_composite(sprite, (x * TILE, y * TILE))
        if solid:
            for sy in range(math.ceil(sprite.height / TILE)):
                for sx in range(math.ceil(sprite.width / TILE)):
                    alpha = sprite.getchannel("A").crop((sx * TILE, sy * TILE, (sx + 1) * TILE, (sy + 1) * TILE))
                    if sum(alpha.histogram()[64:]) > 64 and 0 <= y + sy < HEIGHT and 0 <= x + sx < WIDTH:
                        blocked[y + sy][x + sx] = True

    def plaza(x, y, w, h):
        reserve(x, y, w, h, 2)
        for ty in range(y, y + h):
            for tx in range(x, x + w):
                paths.add((tx, ty))

    def path(points, radius=2):
        for (ax, ay), (bx, by) in zip(points, points[1:]):
            steps = max(abs(bx - ax), abs(by - ay))
            for i in range(steps + 1):
                x, y = round(ax + (bx - ax) * i / max(1, steps)), round(ay + (by - ay) * i / max(1, steps))
                for ty in range(y - radius, y + radius + 1):
                    for tx in range(x - radius, x + radius + 1):
                        if 2 <= tx < WIDTH - 2 and 2 <= ty < HEIGHT - 2:
                            paths.add((tx, ty))
                reserve(x - radius, y - radius, radius * 2 + 1, radius * 2 + 1, 2)

    plaza(13, 44, 14, 12)
    plaza(13, 19, 14, 10)
    plaza(46, 32, 23, 18)
    plaza(89, 17, 19, 19)
    plaza(93, 53, 15, 11)
    path([(19, 49), (35, 49), (35, 42), (57, 42), (79, 42), (79, 26), (98, 26)])
    path([(19, 49), (19, 24)])
    path([(57, 42), (57, 60), (100, 60), (100, 57)])
    path([(57, 42), (57, 18), (38, 18), (38, 10), (20, 10), (20, 24)], 1)
    path([(98, 26), (98, 44), (105, 44), (105, 57)], 1)

    paving = [crop("Grass 2 layer", x, y) for x in range(10, 16) for y in (0, 1, 2, 4, 5, 13)]
    floor = [crop("Wall", x, 2) for x in range(8, 13)]
    for x, y in sorted(paths):
        inside = all(cell in paths for cell in ((x - 1, y), (x + 1, y), (x, y - 1), (x, y + 1)))
        stamp(rng.choice(floor if inside and rng.random() < 0.97 else paving), x, y)

    for x in range(WIDTH):
        for y in (0, 1, HEIGHT - 2, HEIGHT - 1):
            stamp(crop("Wall", 36 + x % 6, 7 + y % 2), x, y)
            blocked[y][x] = True
    for y in range(2, HEIGHT - 2):
        for x in (0, 1, WIDTH - 2, WIDTH - 1):
            stamp(crop("Wall", 36 + y % 6, 7 + x % 2), x, y)
            blocked[y][x] = True
    reserve(0, 0, WIDTH, 2)
    reserve(0, HEIGHT - 2, WIDTH, 2)
    reserve(0, 0, 2, HEIGHT)
    reserve(WIDTH - 2, 0, 2, HEIGHT)

    def horizontal_wall(x, y, length, gaps=()):
        reserve(x, y, length, 3, 1)
        for dx in range(length):
            if any(a <= x + dx < b for a, b in gaps):
                continue
            stamp(crop("Wall", 2 + dx % 3, 6, 1, 3), x + dx, y)
            for dy in range(3):
                blocked[y + dy][x + dx] = True

    def vertical_wall(x, y, length, gaps=()):
        reserve(x, y, 2, length, 1)
        for dy in range(length):
            if any(a <= y + dy < b for a, b in gaps):
                continue
            stamp(crop("Wall", 2 + (dy % 2), 5, 2, 1), x, y + dy)
            blocked[y + dy][x] = blocked[y + dy][x + 1] = True

    horizontal_wall(10, 15, 21, ((17, 23),))
    horizontal_wall(10, 30, 21, ((16, 23),))
    vertical_wall(10, 18, 12)
    vertical_wall(29, 18, 12, ((23, 27),))
    horizontal_wall(43, 28, 30, ((54, 61),))
    horizontal_wall(43, 52, 30, ((54, 61),))
    vertical_wall(43, 31, 21, ((39, 46),))
    vertical_wall(71, 31, 21, ((39, 46),))
    horizontal_wall(85, 12, 27)
    horizontal_wall(85, 37, 27, ((95, 102),))
    vertical_wall(85, 15, 22, ((23, 30),))
    vertical_wall(110, 15, 22)

    objects = [
        (crop("Props", 0, 0, 2, 4), 14, 46),
        (crop("Props", 4, 1, 2, 3), 25, 45),
        (crop("Props", 6, 6, 2, 2), 24, 53),
        (crop("Props", 2, 1, 2, 3), 13, 19),
        (crop("Props", 4, 1, 2, 3), 25, 20),
        (crop("Props", 6, 6, 2, 2), 24, 26),
        (crop("Props", 6, 0, 2, 6), 47, 32),
        (crop("Props", 9, 0, 2, 6), 65, 32),
        (crop("Props", 0, 0, 2, 4), 47, 46),
        (crop("Props", 0, 0, 2, 4), 66, 46),
        (crop("Props", 0, 5, 6, 3), 95, 18),
        (crop("Props", 6, 0, 2, 6), 89, 17),
        (crop("Props", 9, 0, 2, 6), 105, 17),
        (crop("Props", 0, 0, 2, 4), 90, 31),
        (crop("Props", 0, 0, 2, 4), 105, 31),
        (crop("Props", 10, 6, 4, 3), 98, 54),
        (crop("Props", 6, 6, 2, 2), 94, 61),
        (crop("Props", 6, 6, 2, 2), 106, 61),
    ]
    stamp(crop("Props", 7, 8, 3, 2), 56, 37)
    stamp(crop("Props", 7, 8, 3, 2), 97, 24)
    for sprite, x, y in objects:
        reserve(x, y, math.ceil(sprite.width / TILE), math.ceil(sprite.height / TILE), 1)

    trees = [crop("Plants", x, 0, w, 7) for x, w in ((0, 4), (4, 4), (8, 3), (11, 3), (14, 3), (17, 4))]
    for _ in range(1700):
        tree = rng.choice(trees)
        x, y = rng.randrange(3, WIDTH - 7), rng.randrange(2, HEIGHT - 9)
        w, h = tree.width // TILE, tree.height // TILE
        if any(reserved[ty][tx] for ty in range(y, y + h) for tx in range(x, x + w)):
            continue
        objects.append((tree, x, y))
        reserve(x, y, w, h)

    bushes = [crop("Plants", x, 1, 2, 2) for x in (21, 23, 25, 27, 29)]
    for _ in range(650):
        x, y = rng.randrange(3, WIDTH - 4), rng.randrange(3, HEIGHT - 4)
        if any(reserved[ty][tx] for ty in range(y, y + 2) for tx in range(x, x + 2)):
            continue
        objects.append((rng.choice(bushes), x, y))
        reserve(x, y, 2, 2)

    for x0, y0, w, h in ((6, 36, 8, 6), (27, 56, 10, 9), (62, 7, 13, 12), (80, 53, 9, 12), (102, 6, 10, 4)):
        for y in range(y0, y0 + h):
            for x in range(x0, x0 + w):
                if not reserved[y][x] and rng.random() < 0.7:
                    stamp(crop("Grass 2 layer", rng.randrange(0, 4), rng.choice((1, 2, 8, 11, 15))), x, y)

    for sprite, x, y in sorted(objects, key=lambda obj: obj[2] * TILE + obj[0].height):
        stamp(sprite, x, y, solid=True)

    def can_stand(x, y):
        return 1 <= x < WIDTH - 1 and 1 <= y < HEIGHT - 1 and not any(
            blocked[ty][tx] for ty in range(y - 1, y + 2) for tx in range(x - 1, x + 2)
        )

    assert can_stand(*SPAWN), "Spawn is blocked"
    visited = {SPAWN}
    queue = deque([SPAWN])
    while queue:
        x, y = queue.popleft()
        for cell in ((x - 1, y), (x + 1, y), (x, y - 1), (x, y + 1)):
            if cell not in visited and can_stand(*cell):
                visited.add(cell)
                queue.append(cell)
    for target in ((19, 24), (57, 42), (98, 26), (104, 60), (38, 18)):
        assert target in visited, f"Area at {target} is unreachable"

    world = world.convert("RGB")
    unique = [{}, {}]
    cells = []
    for y in range(HEIGHT):
        for x in range(WIDTH):
            tile = world.crop((x * TILE, y * TILE, (x + 1) * TILE, (y + 1) * TILE))
            group = int(blocked[y][x])
            key = tile.tobytes()
            if key not in unique[group]:
                unique[group][key] = (len(unique[group]), tile)
            cells.append((group, unique[group][key][0]))
    first_solid = len(unique[0])
    count = first_solid + len(unique[1])
    atlas = Image.new("RGB", (32 * TILE, math.ceil(count / 32) * TILE))
    for group in (0, 1):
        for index, tile in unique[group].values():
            tile_id = index + (first_solid if group else 0)
            atlas.paste(tile, ((tile_id % 32) * TILE, (tile_id // 32) * TILE))

    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    atlas.save(output / "tileset.bmp")
    ids = [index + (first_solid if group else 0) for group, index in cells]
    rows = [" ".join(map(str, ids[y * WIDTH:(y + 1) * WIDTH])) for y in range(HEIGHT)]
    (output / "world.map").write_text(f"{WIDTH} {HEIGHT} {TILE} {first_solid}\n" + "\n".join(rows) + "\n", encoding="ascii")
    preview.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    world.save(preview)
    print(f"World: {world.width}x{world.height}, atlas: {atlas.width}x{atlas.height}, {count} tiles ({first_solid} passable)")
    print(f"Spawn: (624, 1584); {len(visited)} reachable cells with a 3x3 clearance; all five landmarks reachable")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Build the 32px world atlas from the original Resurrected RPG 1.1 ZIP. Requires Pillow; the game only needs the generated BMP and MAP files. The MAP header is width height tile_size first_solid_tile, followed by row-major tile IDs.")
    parser.add_argument("archive", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, default=ROOT / "assets")
    parser.add_argument("--preview", type=Path, default=ROOT / "build" / "map-preview.png")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    build(args.archive, args.output, args.preview)
```
